_note: Character-creation constants. Every value with a 'verify' id is confirmed against the owned core rulebook / Companion PDFs in the Phase-4 verification pass before release — do not trust unverified numbers.

startingKarma.verified: core rulebook p67 Step Five — the 50 Karma of customization every character receives; the Companion repeats it for each alternate method ('You still gain 50 points of customization Karma', p28)

qualityNetBonusKarmaCap.verified: core rulebook p67 — 'the net bonus Karma cannot be more than 20'

qualityMaxCount.verified: core rulebook p67 — 'You can't select more than six total qualities at character creation' (free racial qualities excluded)

oneAttributeAtMax.verified: core rulebook p66 — only one attribute may start at its metatype maximum; the same paragraph caps skills separately, and Edge is not one of the eight standard attributes

skillCreationCap.verified: core rulebook p66 — 'During character creation, skills can be purchased up to rank 6 (7 with the Aptitude Quality). Only one skill can be put at that maximum level (6 or 7).'

knowledgePointsFormula.verified: core rulebook p68 — 'a certain number of free Knowledge and Language skills at character creation ... equal to their Logic, plus one free Native Language'

contactPointsFormula.verified: core rulebook p68 — 'you have a total of Charisma x 6 points to spend on Connection and Loyalty ratings for your contacts, and at this point, neither rating can be higher than the character's Charisma'

karmaToNuyen.verified: core rulebook p67 — 'The exchange rate is 2,000 nuyen per Karma, or 5,000 with the In Debt quality.'
karmaToNuyen.maxKarmaNote: The core rules state no explicit cap on karma converted to nuyen; the 10-karma limit is this project's guard rail and can be changed on the optional-rules screen.

nuyenToKarma.verified: Sixth World Companion p154, 'Working for the Man/People/Organleggers' — 'by Working for the People, in the course of a week they can exchange 2,000 nuyen for 1 Karma'.
nuyenToKarma.note: OPTIONAL and post-creation only. The core rules move karma to nuyen at creation (p67) but never the reverse; this is a downtime activity costing one week per karma, so it is off by default and lives in advancement, not the wizard.
nuyenToKarma.organleggerVariant: Companion p155 offers up to 3 karma at 4,000 nuyen each, but that nuyen may only be spent on augmentations — not modelled.

spellsAtCreation.verified: core rulebook p66 — full magicians 'get a number of spells or rituals equal to their Magic x 2 — the rating used for that calculation is the Magic in the Priority table, not as altered with any points, Karma, or any other adjustments'; extras cost 5 Karma (p70, and Companion p29 'either 2 CP or 5 Karma each')

complexFormsAtCreation.verified: core rulebook p66 — technomancers 'select a number of complex forms equal to Resonance x 2 (using the Resonance figure from the Priority table, not the number as adjusted)'

mysticAdeptPowerPoints.verified: core rulebook p67 — mystic adepts 'must split their Magic between spells and adept powers. They first purchase adept powers up to a maximum of their Magic attribute then multiply the remaining Magic by 2 to determine their starting number of spell choices.' Power points are a split of the priority Magic, NOT bought with Karma.

adeptPowerPoints.verified: core rulebook p67 — 'Adepts have a pool of points equal to their Magic (as listed in the Priority table, before any adjustments)'

aspectedPickOne.verified: core rulebook p66 — 'Aspected magicians are only able to utilize one of the three aspects of magic: spellcasting (Sorcery), summoning (Conjuring), or enchanting (Enchanting)', and gain an extra point of Magic to compensate

karmaBuild._source: NOT from an English rulebook. Commlink6 1.14.0 KarmaCharacterGenerator sets startKarma = 1000; attributes and skills use the shared advancement price (5 x new rank), metatype and Magic/Resonance use their data karma costs. Override on the optional-rules screen if your table uses different numbers.

karmaCosts._verified: core rulebook p68-70 — 'Spend 5 Karma x new level to advance ... for each rank'; the Attribute and Skill Advancement table (p69) is the cumulative form of the same 5 x new rank rule
karmaCosts._verifiedKnowledge: core rulebook p69 — 'New Knowledge skills cost 3 Karma' (a flat rate, unlike active skills at 5 x new rank)

defaults._note: Fallbacks when neither a world override nor the selected rule interpretation supplies a value. Names match the setting vocabulary in extractor/chargen_xml.py RULE_SETTING_NAMES.
defaults.verified: core rulebook p68 — 'you can't go into the game with more than' 5,000 nuyen; availability 6 and the 5-karma leftover are the core creation limits
